title: Spec review
description: The review of one repository's specification documents against the implementation-level criteria of effective-architecture/review-criteria.json, and the two documents that can follow it: an author's correction and the decider's ruling on a dispute. The root is the reviewer's result; spec-correction.schema.json and spec-ruling.schema.json refer to the other two.

SpecDocument.description: Which of the repository's three specification documents: `spec` is spec-<slug>.md, `data-model` is spec-<slug>.data-model.md, `criteria` is spec-<slug>.criteria.md.

RulingValue.description: `finding-stands`: the reviewer is right and the author applies the directive. `document-stands`: the document stays as its author left it.

Finding.description: One defect in one specification document, measured against one implementation-level criterion.

id.description: The reviewer's name for this finding, unique in the review: F1, F2 and so on.

criterion.description: The id of the implementation-level criterion the document does not meet, as effective-architecture/review-criteria.json states it.

location.description: The heading in the document where the defect is, or where the missing detail belongs.

observation.description: What the document says or lacks, stated as a fact a reader can check.

correction.description: The bounded change that removes the defect.

doneWhen.description: The condition that shows the correction is made.

SpecReview.description: The reviewer's result. An empty findings list means the three documents meet the implementation-level criteria.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was reviewed and what was found.

Dispute.description: A finding the author of the document did not apply, with its reason.

findingId.description: The id of the disputed finding, as the review states it.

reason.description: Why the document is right as it stands.

evidence.description: Where the reason can be checked: a path and heading, or a documentation URL.

SpecCorrection.description: An author's result for its one correction of its own document. Every finding on the document that is not listed in disputes is corrected in the document.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was changed in the document.

Ruling.description: The decider's ruling on one disputed finding.

findingId.description: The id of the disputed finding, as the review states it.

reason.description: Why this side prevails, from the evidence the two sides gave.

directive.description: For `finding-stands`, the change the author makes in the document. For `document-stands`, an empty string.

SpecRuling.description: The decider's result: one ruling for each disputed finding.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was ruled.
